gate.denseRows: raw characterization: candidate and bf16-reference fixture outcomes are recorded as observations and never reject a dense row
gate.compressedRows: every threshold compares the compressed-KV run with the dense-KV run on the same weights; the bf16 reference model is weight-quantization characterization only and never the gate denominator
gate.nonDiscriminatingNeedle: when the same-weights dense-KV run misses the needle, the compressed needle check requires exact agreement with the dense output and the receipt records needleDiscriminating=false
gate.nonDiscriminatingTool: when the same-weights dense-KV run does not emit the valid structured tool call, compressed tool agreement is exact equality with that dense output and the receipt records toolDiscriminating=false
gate.repeats: discrimination flags are the AND over all sealed repeats; each repeat records its own flag, and compressed rows must pass every repeat

multiTurnFixture.turns: turn 1 is the frozen cache-fixture prompt, generated and stored through the product prompt cache; turn 2 is turn 1's conversation, turn 1's answer, and the follow-up, served by a prompt-cache hit over turn 1 (a compressed row imports the reused prefix into its compressed cache, a dense row seeds its dense cache); both arms run the same flow, record each turn's cache hit and reused-prefix tokens, and a turn 2 that is not served by the hit is refused
multiTurnFixture.followUp: Now repeat that same stable baseline fact once more, in one short sentence.
multiTurnFixture.metric: teacher-forced per-position argmax agreement of turn 2 after its prompt-cache hit: a compressed row against the same-weights dense-KV turn-2 greedy continuation (stop tokens decoded through, 1024 positions, a fit-boundary row shortened to its remaining context window), a dense row against the reference's natural turn-2 stream; every measured repeat must meet the threshold
multiTurnFixture.observations: turn 2's free-running first divergence and matched-prefix length are recorded and never gated

needleFixture.question: What is the special magic identifier mentioned in the text above? Reply with only the identifier.

statistics.outlierPolicy: report all samples; no silent deletion
statistics.variancePolicy: all raw repeats retained; decode throughput coefficient of variation must stay within the frozen maximum
